voice.name: Antonin - Warm, Unsettling, Elegant
voice.why: Marcel Brun counts the containers at the yard and cooks the books for a cut: soft, smiling, middle-aged and a little too friendly. Antonin is a warm, confident French voice with something unsettling under it, nothing like the café owner's charm, the harbour master's rasp or the go-between's level calm. No other speaker uses this voice.

fee_short.text: That is not enough. Come back with the full amount.

fee_held.text: You already have one. Keep your money.

fee_failed.text: Not now. Your pockets are full. Your money is still yours.

greet.text: Marcel, tally clerk. I count what comes off the ships and I write down what the customs man wants written. Funny thing. Container nine is short this week.

offer.text: Four hundred dollars, and it stays short on the books. You carry the key, you take what is in it, and in a while it fills up again. I never saw you.

key.text: Here. Brass, on a red string. Container nine, back row, past the crane. Take what is in it, lock it up after. The books will say it never came.

later.text: Not while the customs man is here. Come back when your pockets are full and the yard is quiet.

replies.later: I need to think about it.
